methodology: Frozen-input experiments copy the actual low-resolution HDR and scene depth after rendering the main nebula from the global belt midplane. The engine is stopped while variants render the same proxy, camera, uniforms and textures to RGBA32F, with blending disabled.

Split renders matching reconstruction pixels and full-raymarch fallback pixels in separate disjoint draws. Weighted rejects individual depth-incompatible bilinear taps and normalizes surviving weights, with full raymarch when none survive.
Each variant has 6 warm-up draws and 40 EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 samples. Baseline is repeated last. Disjoint state, software renderer, empty reference and GL errors invalidate the experiment.

Image metrics compare uncomposited premultiplied HDR components against a full-resolution raymarch using the same frozen inputs. Relative error is sum(abs(reference-candidate))/sum(abs(reference)); edge metrics select baseline fallback pixels. These are two static views, not universal image equality.

Actual application stage profiles have 32 samples per draw after 5 seconds at the selected view, on the dev build with cloud assets. These GPU stage durations must not be converted into whole-frame FPS or summed as whole-frame medians.
Initial empty-proxy, navigation-interrupted and ERR_NO_BUFFER_SPACE runs are excluded. Only completed error-free measurements are archived. Driver warnings remain recorded.
